tess.sales: Quick POC blocking note for BlueGrocer. They're on Okta; SCIM push shows 204 but no users in tenant bluegrocer-poc. SAML NameID is 'transient' and Okta mapped externalId to 'group.id'. Need help. cc @ryan.eng @omar.se
ryan.eng: transient NameID won't map to an email. For our SSO flow we need NameID=emailAddress or include an email attribute. Also using group.id for externalId is risky because group pushes can reuse ids. Can you paste the Okta SCIM mappings screenshot?
tess.sales: attached screenshot (redacted). Mapping has externalId = app.user.groupid and userName = user.id. They said the SCIM request returns 204 in Okta logs. Our SCIM logs show a 409 duplicate for externalId followed by client returned 204. Tenant: bluegrocer-poc.
omar.se: 409 means we rejected due to duplicate externalId. Okta sometimes flattens group membership and pushes duplicates. Fixes: set externalId/userName to user.login or user.email; ensure NameID is email. Example recommended mapping: {"userName":"user.login","externalId":"user.login","emails":["user.email"]}.
tess.sales: they asked if we can issue a temporary SCIM-only token and a short-lived inference key to run a throughput check on a Dedicated test pool while they fix mappings. Also concerned about security for sharing tokens in screenshots.
ellen.sec: we can issue scoped, expiring tokens for trials. Reminder: Private/VPC customers may require traffic from fixed IPs or mTLS; BlueGrocer is hosted trial so bearer token is acceptable but we must DM the secret to the designated admin only and not accept tokens via ticketing screenshots. If their network uses a proxy that rewrites the Authorization header, that'll explain 401/403.
omar.se: i'll create scim_token_bg_24h scoped to /scim and tmp_infer_bg_4h scoped to inference:generate on pool dedicated-test-bg. Will expire in 24h and 4h respectively. After that, run this curl from their network to verify auth:
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer SCIM_TOKEN_HERE\" -H \"Content-Type: application/scim+json\" https://scim.redwood-inference.example.com/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
tess.sales: thanks. i told the Okta admin to change NameID to EmailAddress and set externalId to user.login, then re-run group push and paste logs. I'll only send the token via DM.
scim-bot: SCIM push from okta.bluegrocer.example.com -> /scim/v2/Users returned 409 at 1779991245 (duplicate externalId)
omar.se: tokens created: scim_token_bg_24h (expires=1779994840), tmp_infer_bg_4h (expires=1779992611). DMing secrets to Tess. Please confirm when they re-run group push; we'll watch logs for 201/200 responses and user creation events.
tess.sales: received the secrets, sent to BlueGrocer admin with mapping examples and SAML snippet to set NameID to email. asked them not to paste tokens in the ticket. will update when they confirm users appear.
ryan.eng: if they still see 204 in Okta but users missing, have them capture the raw request/response headers and body from their side; Okta's 204 can mask downstream errors. Also offer a short SAML metadata file if they need it.
tess.sales: will do. closing thread for now, will reopen if they hit more issues. :white_check_mark:
